	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>Our Superior Rooms are located on the ground floor with direct access to the resort's patio and garden, and just a few footsteps from the beach. All Deluxe Rooms are fitted with a Queen Bed, and air-conditioning and each has its own private bathroom. Perfect for anyone who wants direct access from their room to the beach.</p>
